# Codex CLI 0.165.0 identity

Frozen npm and GitHub identity for official stable `0.165.0` after the
`0.164.0` ceiling. One published stable hop. Wrapper and native
`darwin-arm64` / `linux-x64` tarballs were hashed and inventoried. No
downloaded vendor binary was executed. Public `rust-v*` tags plus those
hashed artifacts are identity evidence; the shipped bwrap behavior and attached-child lifecycle remain unqualified. `0.166.0-alpha.5` is ignored.
No prompt, login, or live session.

`0.164.0` native identities reuse Research 452. `bin/codex.js` stays
byte-identical. Complete per-file `0.165.0` artifact inventories live in
`artifact-inventory/`. The source hop delta lives in
`source-name-status.tsv` with rename detection off.
